notes: mpHVS1–mpHVS13: Retained as candidates_found. The paper explicitly selects all 13 as unbound in the Xue08 model (T:p4-b1) and later states that all 13 HVS candidates are unbound in some Galactic potential models, though only mpHVS1 is unbound with high statistical significance after the proper-motion correction and most of the others could be bound (T:p7-b3); the conclusion still reports 13 HVS candidates (T:p8-b1). SDSS J074557.31+181246.7: Included as follow_up because Kollmeier et al. (2009) previously identified it as an HVS candidate and this paper checks it, placing it among its bound objects (T:p4-b1).

SDSS J221853.48-004030.9: RA and Dec are transcribed from the SDSS J2000 catalog designation in T:p9-b0 without conversion. The paper also reports V_rf and Galactocentric radial velocities (T:p9-b0, T:p5-b2); these are not entered as radial_velocity because the requested quantity is restricted to heliocentric or barycentric line-of-sight velocities.

SDSS J221625.92+003555.4: RA and Dec are extracted from the SDSS J designation in Table 1 (T:p9-b0); the paper does not provide separate coordinate columns. The Galactocentric radial velocity of −597±177 km/s reported in T:p5-b2 and V_rf = −354±9 km/s in T:p9-b0 are not included as radial_velocity because they are not heliocentric or barycentric line-of-sight velocities. No bound/unbound probabilities are reported.

SDSS J222620.74+004135.6: RA/Dec are the coordinates encoded by the reported SDSS designation in Table 1 (T:p9-b0); no separate astrometric RA/Dec column is provided. Table 1's V_rf = 317±8 km/s (T:p9-b0) is a Galactic-rest-frame radial velocity and was not used for radial_velocity; RV⊙ is used instead. D_G in Table 3 (T:p10-b0) is labeled Galactocentric distance and is treated as the galactocentric_radius. The paper describes mpHVS3 as unbound in the tested potentials (T:p4-b1) but reports no numerical bound/unbound probabilities.

SDSS J172915.20+431717.2: The RA and Dec are taken from the SDSS designation for mpHVS4 (SDSS J172915.20+431717.2); the paper does not give separate coordinate columns and no conversion to decimal degrees was applied. The listed V_rf (−315±5 km/s) and the Galactocentric radial velocity for mpHVS4 are not recorded as radial_velocity because the quantity rules exclude velocities relative to the local/Galactic rest frame; RV⊙ is the heliocentric radial velocity. No numerical bound/unbound probabilities are reported for this star; the paper only states model-dependent bound/unbound status.

SDSS J125210.66+300147.9: RA and Dec are not tabulated separately; they are encoded in the reported SDSS designation J125210.66+300147.9 in T:p9-b0. The paper reports no numerical bound/unbound probability for mpHVS5; it only classifies it as unbound in the Xue08 model and bound in the Gnedin05 model in T:p10-b0. The Table 1 V_rf value is a Galactic radial velocity, not a heliocentric/barycentric radial velocity, so it was not used for radial_velocity.

SDSS J074817.52+360034.4: RA and Dec were parsed from the SDSS catalog designation in Table 1; no separate coordinate columns are given. The text reports a Galactocentric radial velocity of 364±223 km s^-1 for mpHVS6 (T:p6-b1), but this is not a heliocentric or barycentric radial velocity and is therefore not entered as radial_velocity. No bound/unbound probabilities are reported.

SDSS J123237.34+165526.9: RA and Dec are available only through the SDSS catalog identifier; they are recorded in the original sexagesimal notation without conversion. No parallax or bound/unbound probabilities are reported. At T:p10-b0, mpHVS7 has V_G above V_esc(Xue08)=475 km/s but below V_esc(Gnedin05)=590 km/s, so its bound status is potential-model dependent.

SDSS J121112.12+402029.5: The RA and Dec values are decoded from the SDSS J2000 designation in the Catalog column; the paper does not provide separate RA/Dec columns (T:p9-b0, I:p9-b0). The Tabulated V_rf = 373±5 km/s is explicitly the Galactic-rest-frame radial velocity, so it is not recorded as `radial_velocity`; the heliocentric RV_odot = 340±5 km/s is recorded (T:p9-b0). The paper reports that mpHVS8 is unbound in the Xue08 model but bound in the Gnedin05 model, with no bound/unbound probability values (T:p4-b1, T:p10-b0).

SDSS J172733.94+322459.1: RA and Dec are taken directly from the SDSS J designation without conversion. The listed Vrf = -392±18 km s−1 (T:p9-b0) is a Galactic-rest-frame radial velocity and is excluded by the radial-velocity definition; the Galactocentric radial velocity -273±262 km s−1 (T:p6-b1) is likewise not heliocentric/barycentric. No numerical bound or unbound probabilities are reported; the paper only gives model-dependent bound/unbound status.

SDSS J171826.16+645745.8: mpHVS10 is one of the 13 candidates unbound in the Xue08 model but bound in the Gnedin05 model (T:p4-b1, T:p10-b0); the paper does not report a numerical bound/unbound probability. The value V_rf = 384±8 km/s in T:p9-b0 is a Galactic-rest-frame radial velocity, so it is not used for radial_velocity; RV⊙ = 189±8 km/s is the heliocentric value.

SDSS J124814.84+284010.2: RA and Dec are encoded in the SDSS catalog identifier in Table 1 (T:p9-b0); the paper does not provide separate coordinate columns. The Table 1 value V_rf = 371±8 km/s is a Galactic-rest-frame radial velocity, not the requested heliocentric line-of-sight radial velocity, so it is not recorded. No bound or unbound probability is reported; the paper only gives model-dependent binding status, with mpHVS11 unbound in the Xue08 model and bound in the Gnedin05 model (T:p4-b1, T:p10-b0).

SDSS J160912.29+345706.8: In T:p9-b0, mpHVS12 has V_rf = -295 ± 4 km/s, a Galactic-rest-frame line-of-sight velocity; it is neither the heliocentric/barycentric radial velocity nor the total 3D Galactic-rest-frame speed, so it was not mapped to `radial_velocity` or `galactic_rest_frame_velocity`. The RA and Dec values are encoded in the SDSS J160912.29+345706.8 designation rather than listed in separate coordinate columns (T:p9-b0). No parallax or bound/unbound probabilities are reported.

SDSS J203328.51+142607.0: No parallax or bound/unbound probabilities are reported for mpHVS13. The paper states that mpHVS13 has [Fe/H] outside the valid range of the photometric parallax relation, so its tabulated D⊙ and velocity estimates are retained as reported but are explicitly cautioned as invalid (T:p4-b1). Table 3 gives V_G = 499 ± 124 km/s versus V_esc = 497 km/s (Xue08) and 610 km/s (Gnedin05), so mpHVS13 is unbound in Xue08 but bound in Gnedin05; no probabilities are given (T:p10-b0).

SDSS J074557.31+181246.7: The target SDSS J074557.31+181246.7 appears only in the text at T:p4-b1: "only SDSS J074557.31+181246.7 is selected out and belongs to our bound objects" — referring to a cross-check of the six Kollmeier et al. (2009) metal-poor HVS candidates against this paper's high-velocity sample. The star is stated to be a bound object, but no astrometric, kinematic, distance, or probability quantities are reported for it. It is not listed in Tables 1–3 (which contain only mpHVS1–mpHVS13, none of which is this object). Therefore no eligible quantities can be extracted.
